name: snapshot
description: Look at a video: a grid sheet (default), every frame (frames all), one full frame (at), or one labelled sheet of up to 36 times (at repeated). Look at footage in two calls: sheets of all the clips (`inputs`, 12 a sheet), then one sheet of the moments you pick (`at`, several times).

output.description: JPEG image — contact sheet (grid mode) or single frame (--at mode), or a directory path followed by frame list (all-frames mode).

params.name: inputs
params.description: Several clips: a sheet of up to 12, a row per clip (cols frames each, default 6), tiles labelled with name and time. More make sheets <out>-2.jpg, -3.jpg ..., one path per line.

params.name: names
params.description: A label per inputs clip (its clip id).

params.name: cols
params.description: Grid columns (grid mode, or a sheet of several at)

params.name: start
params.description: Window start in seconds (grid / all-frames mode)

params.name: end
params.description: Window end in seconds (grid / all-frames mode)

params.name: frames
params.description: Number of frames to sample (grid mode), or 'all' to extract every frame in the window

params.name: at
params.description: Seconds. One: a single full-resolution frame (scene continuity, regen stitching). Several (up to 36): one sheet of those times, each tile labelled, cols columns (default up to 6). Not with frames, rows, start, end.

params.name: faces
params.description: Also answer each clip's head box (source pixels, at the tile times).

params.name: out
params.description: Output file path (grid and at modes) or directory (all-frames mode). Defaults to <input>_snapshot.jpg / <input>_at_<sec>.jpg / <input>_at_<first>-<last>.jpg / <input>_frames/.
